agreement_scope_raw.value: University-wide/Law restricted - Erasmus will be used coming years EAIE 2026

min_standing_note.value: CAHSS applicants must show >=1 full year of completed university study at application (case-by-case if from prior institution); College of Science & Engineering applicants must show >=1 completed semester.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel scope specifies 'University-wide/Law restricted - Erasmus will be used coming years EAIE 2026'.

eligible_majors.notes: University-wide exchange agreement with Law restricted and specific school exclusions per Fact Sheet.

excluded_majors.notes: Fact Sheet p.4 bars these areas unless coming on a subject-specific agreement; Excel Col H also flags Law restricted.

min_gpa_host.notes: Cumulative GPA >=3.0/4.0 (or B average / ECTS 'C') at home university.

english_course_availability.notes: UK research university teaching all regular courses in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Standard requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 (5.5 each band) or TOEFL iBT 92 (20 each section), higher for some 3rd-yr humanities/social science courses. Exempt if studying at an Edinburgh-approved English-medium university, or if on <6 month Standard Visitor route (unless taking 3rd/4th-yr courses per Fact Sheet p.5).

host_language_requirement.value: English only; in-session English Language Education support available (p.5).

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Semester 1: Welcome Week Sep 14, Teaching Sep 21 - Dec 4, Semester ends Dec 21, 2026 (incl. revision & exams).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Semester 2: January Welcome Jan 6, Teaching Jan 11 - Apr 2, 2027, Spring break & exams ending May 21, 2027.

tuition_model.notes: Reciprocal International Exchange students do not pay tuition to the University of Edinburgh.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official University of Edinburgh AY 2026-2027 UG cost-of-living average £1,546/month (£13,914 per 39-wk AY; £18,552 per 52-wk yr): Accommodation & utilities £980 avg (range £752-1,249), food £248, socialising/leisure £248, local bus £58 (often free under age 22 via Young Scot NEC), mobile £12. Separate UK Student Visa outside-London threshold is £1,203/mo.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly GBP range 1,546/month. ECB cross-rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD and 1 EUR = 0.83559 GBP -> 1 GBP = 1.322658 USD (2026-11-13, retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); 5-month USD est = 1,546.0 GBP * 5 * 1.322658 = 10,224.15 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Single-semester students in private (non-university) accommodation may owe UK Council Tax; Student Route (>6 mo) requires Immigration Health Surcharge for NHS access; Standard Visitor (<=6 mo) receives free emergency/NHS treatment but travel/medical insurance recommended; resit exam charges apply.

housing_availability.notes: International Exchange students are guaranteed University accommodation provided they apply by the accommodation deadline (Jul 31 Sep start / Nov 30 Jan start in 2024-25 PDF); specific hall preference not guaranteed.

housing_notes.value: Apply post-offer via http://www.accom.ed.ac.uk/applying/ready-to-apply; contents insurance included in university accommodation rent (2026-27 ed.ac.uk estimates acc + utilities avg £980/mo, £752-1,249).

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No University of Edinburgh incoming exchange stipend verified.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: <=6 months (1 semester): Standard Visitor route / Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) for non-visa nationals or advance Standard Visitor visa for visa nationals (no Student Route financial proof). >6 months (full year): full UK Student Visa (CAS) requiring £1,203/month outside-London funds (up to £10,827 for 9 mo) plus Immigration Health Surcharge.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Student Visa financial requirements also at https://www.ed.ac.uk/student-administration/immigration/student-visa/financial-requirements.

english_course_list_url.notes: All courses in the Study Abroad Course Finder (https://www.ed.ac.uk/global/study-abroad/course-finder) are taught in English; no separate English-only URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: Scottish credit framework: standard and mandatory full-time load is strictly 60 credits per semester (majority of courses 20 cr/sem or 40 cr/yr); students cannot normally take >60 or <60 credits.

course_restrictions_note.value: Excluded unless subject-specific agreement: Medicine, Veterinary Medicine, Studio Arch/Art/Design, Education & Sport. High-pressure/no guarantee (incl. Law per Excel & PDF p.4): Law, Politics, Informatics, History, Psychology, Classics, Archaeology, English Lit, Geography, Music, Philosophy, Health, Nursing, Art/Design electives, AEVS/EIBC. Add/drop closes end of teaching week 2.

required_application_docs.notes: Fact Sheet p.4 explicitly states academic references are NOT required; allow 6 weeks processing.

academic_style.value: Ancient Scottish research university (est. 1583) with formal 20-credit semester modules, strict add/drop deadline (week 2), and separate exam diets; transcripts issued Feb (S1) / Aug (S2/FY).

city_tier.notes: Fact Sheet p.1 describes Edinburgh as 'Scotland's vibrant capital city' (Edinburgh city ~500k inhabitants, though UK non-capital/Scottish capital tier ambiguity makes mid_size_city vs capital_or_major_metro ambiguous without explicit census figure).

campus_type.notes: Fact Sheet p.2 describes multiple Edinburgh campuses: George Square (central, CAHSS + Informatics + Main Library) and The King's Buildings (Science & Engineering, 2 km south), connected by free University shuttle bus.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated in Fact Sheet or ed.ac.uk (UK English-speaking city & campus).

international_support_services.value: Edinburgh Global, EUSA Student Union (270+ societies, 65 sports clubs), Edinburgh/Global Buddies schemes, Advice Place, Nightline, Wellbeing/Disability/Counselling Services, Career Service, Sport & Exercise, and free campus shuttle.

nomination_deadlines.value: Student Application Deadlines (after home nomination): May 31 for September start (apply early May for July offer/housing); October 31 for January start (apply early Oct for Nov offer); strict, no late apps.
